title: First New Orleans bass players and Steve Brown
summary: Braud names Kimball and Steve Brown as the first bassists he heard and praises Brown's work with Paul Whiteman and his own care for tone.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Have you any idea who the first people were that played bass? Who was maybe the first one?

Well, I had them. The first I heard were Billy Murray, Kimball, and Steve Brown, one of the finest, too. I knew him in the front. I'm a Goldcats kitten. Well, he's from New Orleans. Yeah. He played with the Browns Band. He left here with the Browns Band around 1913. And he have a son. I don't know if he's still a player, but he's one of the finest, I heard Steve Brown's son. Steve Brown is now the business agent for the Detroit local.
I met him in Detroit. His brother is still here.

And he's very, very fine. He didn't read anything. But I'm telling you, you couldn't tell a different way that your man just knew. He sat in in the Paul Whiteman Band. He made some of the finest records Paul Whiteman Band made in the bass line. The finest I heard. And a very fine fellow. And he thinks there's nobody in the world like me. Now he thinks I'm the greatest. And I think he's the greatest. See what I mean?

If you ever hear in his record, you can tell. You see, I, myself, I'm very cranky about the tones. I played whole notes for hours when I was playing that for the tone. That's why I could deliver the tone that I do deliver on the bass. I know I have a good tone on the bass. I might be the best. But anyway, with the bow of the fingers. Because you hear some records, you don't hear a bass. You hear this. You see? You hear a knocking like you're knocking against a bow. Well, that comes from people that didn't study tones. Whole notes is very essential in music because you get the tone in your ear. And also, to make a better tone, the chromatics is very essential. You play chromatics for hours, nothing else. You've got to get the tone in your head. You know what I mean? And then, in the meantime, the artist must have some kind of natural ability, too. You know? You must have some natural ability to be a player of any kind.
